$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the photography pack composed with a New York headshot photographer's content seed (Kaito Mori), an ink brand, and the seamless register. home.layout "stack" in the seed turns the home page into the photographer's stack — every headshot at one size, full bleed, on white caption bands set at the column's left edge, closed by the price line and a text link. Everything else — builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Headshot photographer
description: A headshot photographer's site on white: one full-bleed stack of faces on tomato, cobalt and sage seamless, every frame the same size, each named on a white band, then the session and its price in one line and a text link to book. Client selects galleries and a live studio calendar behind it — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's /book page and Manage calendar open on Kaito's own sessions, not the base demo photographer's.

types.name: Headshot session
types.description: Ninety minutes, three looks on three colors of seamless, retouched selects in two days. $650.

types.name: Quick refresh
types.description: One look, one color, forty-five minutes — for a new haircut or a new season. $325.

types.name: Press portrait
types.description: Two hours for musicians and authors: studio headshots plus a few frames with the instrument or the book. $850.

theme.$comment: The seamless register's brand overlay: the preset's own ink accents as the project brand, so app surfaces wear the same white-wall register as the marketing pages (the pages resolve brand over preset accent; identical values mean no shift). mode light opens on the white wall — the base photographer opens dark, and theme merges shallowly. navigation re-pins the shared photographyShell chrome to the burger overlay: the name alone on the white wall, the links and the ask folded away, so the seamless colors are the only thing on the page.

landing.$comment: The seamless register over the base's routes. pages replaces the base's skeletons wholesale, so all six routed pages are pinned: home is the stack (gallery sequence with a band captionStack, closed by the colophon banner); the rest keep the base's compositions.
